extracted.name: Banana Bread- Chocolate Walnut 🍌
extracted.description: A tasty banana bread recipe that the whole family will love. 🟢
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 325*. Spray or butter a 8 ½ x 4 ½ inch loaf pan. Pan should be well coated to avoid bread from sticking.nonce pan is prepared move onto the bread mixture. In a large bowl mash the bananas with a fork. This should make around two cups of banana mash.

Mix in oil, vanilla, sugar, and egg. Stirring until well combined. Next, Add in baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Mix this together until combined then add in the flour. Once batter is just incorporated then add the chocolate chips and walnuts. Continue to stir until well combined. Transfer mixture to prepared baking pan.
Place pan into preheated oven. bake for 60 - 75 minutes or until you can insert a toothpick and it comes out clean. Let cool for 15 minutes. Enjoy!
